contentList.content: Elusive
You are so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand. No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated, and critical hits against you count as normal hits.
Stroke of Luck
If your attack misses a target, you can turn the miss into a hit. Recharges on a Short Rest.
Diamond Soul
Your mastery of ki grants you proficiency in all saving throws. Additionally, whenever you fail a saving throw, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it.
Empty Body
Spend 4 ki points to become invisible for 10 turns. While invisible, you gain resistance to all damage except Force damage.
Opportunist
Whenever an enemy within melee range is struck by an ally's attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.
Vanish
You can use the Hide action as a bonus action on your turn.
Feral Senses
You gain preternatural awareness. You cannot be blinded and can detect invisible creatures within 9m.
Foe Slayer
You add your Wisdom modifier to your attack rolls and weapon damage rolls.
Shadowy Dodge
Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.
Cleansing Touch
Use an action to end harmful spells and magical conditions affecting yourself or an ally.
Purity of Spirit
You are constantly shielded by holy warding. You cannot be charmed or frightened, and gain the continuous effects of Protection from Evil and Good.
Undying Sentinel
When you are reduced to 0 hit points and are not killed outright, you drop to 1 hit point instead. Recharges on a Long Rest.
Supernatural Resistance
You gain resistance to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
Soul of Vengeance
When a creature under your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.
Aura Range Improvement
The radius of your protective paladin auras extends outwards to 9m (30ft).
Focused Conjuration
While concentrating on a Conjuration spell, damage cannot break your concentration.
Dragon Wings
You manifest dragon wings from your draconic heritage, granting you the ability to fly at will and increasing your movement speed.
Storm's Fury
When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 14 Lightning damage to the attacker and push them 6m away.
Shroud of Shadows
You can cast Invisibility at will, without expending a spell slot.
Master of Myriad Forms
You can cast Disguise Self at will, without expending a spell slot.
Spell Mastery (Level 1)
Select a 1st-level wizard spell from your broad repertoire to cast at will without expending a spell slot.
Spell Mastery (Level 2)
Select a 2nd-level wizard spell from your broad repertoire to cast at will without expending a spell slot.
Elder Champion

Assume the mantle of the primeval wilderness for 10 turns. Regain 10 hit points at the start of each of your turns, cast spells with an additional Bonus Action, and project an aura forcing enemies within 3m to have Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells.
Holy Nimbus
Emanate an aura of brilliant sunlight for 10 turns. You gain Advantage on saving throws against spells, and any Fiends or Undead that start their turn within 9m take 10 Radiant damage.
Avenging Angel
Manifest spectral wings granting flight and increased movement speed for 10 turns. Emit an aura of terror that frightens nearby foes, and gain Advantage on attack rolls against frightened creatures.
Dread Lord

Cloak yourself in an aura of suffocating gloom for 10 turns. Enemies within 9m must make a Wisdom save or become Frightened. Frightened foes in the aura take 4d10 Psychic damage at the start of their turn. Unlocks a bonus action shadowy melee attack.
Shadow Attack
Channel the surrounding darkness into a melee strike that deals 3d10 Necrotic damage as a Bonus Action.
Quivering Palm
Strike an enemy to impart lethal, imperceptible vibrations lasting up to 100 turns. Unlocks the ability to detonate the vibrations at will.
Quivering Palm: Detonate

Send lethal shockwaves through a target afflicted with Quivering Palm vibrations. Target must make a Constitution saving throw: takes 100 Necrotic damage on a failure, or 10d10 Necrotic damage on a success.
Hurl Through Hell

Strike a creature and instantly banish it through the lower planes for 1 turn. When it returns at the end of your next turn, it takes 10d10 Psychic damage from the harrowing ordeal (Once per Long Rest).
Death Strike
You have mastered the art of instant death. When you hit a Surprised creature, your attack deals double damage.
Thief's Reflexes
Your reflexes are beyond mortal limits. On the first turn of any combat, gain an additional Action and an additional Bonus Action.
Supreme Healing
When you restore hit points with a spell, or receive healing, you use the highest number possible for each die rolled instead of rolling.
Overchannel
Overpower your simpler spells to deal maximum damage on your next spell. Consecutive uses before finishing a rest deal escalating necrotic damage to yourself.
Master's Flourish
Whenever you use a Blade Flourish option, you can use a 1d6 die instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.
Beast Spells
You can cast your Druid spells while transformed into any Wild Shape form.
Wild Shape: Epic Scaling
Your beast forms attain legendary prowess, gaining increased attack rolls, an extra wild shape charge, and bonus physical damage.
